description: This source file implements the WebAudioPlayerIpc class and related factory functions for IPC communication with a web audio player component, including methods for controlling playback, buffer management, device info, volume, and event subscription.

classes.name: WebAudioPlayerIpc
classes.description: Implements IPC communication for web audio player control, including creation, control, event handling, and destruction.

methods.name: getFactory
methods.description: Returns a shared pointer to the WebAudioPlayerIpcFactory instance.

methods.name: createWebAudioPlayerIpc
methods.description: Creates and returns a unique pointer to a WebAudioPlayerIpc instance with specified parameters.

methods.name: WebAudioPlayerIpc::WebAudioPlayerIpc
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the IPC module, attaches to the channel, and creates the web audio player.

methods.name: WebAudioPlayerIpc::~WebAudioPlayerIpc
methods.description: Destructor that destroys the web audio player, detaches the IPC channel, and resets the event thread.

methods.name: WebAudioPlayerIpc::createRpcStubs
methods.description: Creates RPC stubs for IPC communication.

methods.name: WebAudioPlayerIpc::subscribeToEvents
methods.description: Subscribes to WebAudioPlayerStateEvent events over IPC.

methods.name: WebAudioPlayerIpc::onPlaybackStateUpdated
methods.description: Handles playback state update events and notifies the client.

methods.name: WebAudioPlayerIpc::play
methods.description: Sends a play command via IPC.

methods.name: WebAudioPlayerIpc::pause
methods.description: Sends a pause command via IPC.

methods.name: WebAudioPlayerIpc::setEos
methods.description: Sends an end-of-stream command via IPC.

methods.name: WebAudioPlayerIpc::getBufferAvailable
methods.description: Retrieves available buffer frames and shared memory info via IPC.

methods.name: WebAudioPlayerIpc::getBufferDelay
methods.description: Retrieves buffer delay in frames via IPC.

methods.name: WebAudioPlayerIpc::getDeviceInfo
methods.description: Retrieves device info such as preferred and maximum frames, and support for deferred play.

methods.name: WebAudioPlayerIpc::getVolume
methods.description: Retrieves the current volume via IPC.

methods.name: WebAudioPlayerIpc::createWebAudioPlayer
methods.description: Creates a web audio player with specified MIME type, priority, and configuration.

methods.name: WebAudioPlayerIpc::destroyWebAudioPlayer
methods.description: Destroys the web audio player session.
